title: PersonContact
description: Restricted verified contact point used for allowed direct communications.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

protected_value_ref.description: Reference to encrypted and access-controlled raw contact value.

value_fingerprint.description: Institution-keyed HMAC over channel and normalized contact value for per-person deduplication.

verified_at.description: Successful confirmation time. Absent when pending or revoked.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: A shared contact point can belong to multiple people and must never merge them.
Never return the protected value or fingerprint in roster, metrics, role or audit exports.
Telephone uses normalized E.164 where possible. Email lowercases the domain and preserves local-part semantics.
